edits.new:
# Reconstruct the current #7620 baseline with this actual native inventory
  # and the very same signed caller, not from a projected raw delta.
  baseline_word=read(FROZEN/'7620-WORD.json.gz')
  assert sha256(canonical(baseline_word)).hexdigest()=='6c46ad38d812ae110392f1c977cc6f02665f8860e98ef1c21cb539ff3779533d'
  baseline_native=ind.native(baseline_word);assert not baseline_native['bad_inputs']
  baseline_invoice=ind.invoices(baseline_word,C,baseline_native)
  source_invoice_path=FROZEN/'7620-INVOICE.json'
  assert sha256(source_invoice_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='61aaf72892d2bc2f9fac9dce37b3d62b01d15f4fa47e9f6fa2fceace7735b5ab'
  source_invoice=read(source_invoice_path)
  assert normal(baseline_invoice['P'])==source_invoice['paid'] and normal(baseline_invoice['T'])==source_invoice['targets'], 'Fresh signed #7620 baseline invoice'
  assert baseline_invoice['S']==1424 and not baseline_invoice['empty_root_credits']
  assert sum(baseline_invoice['P'].values())==110145 and sum(baseline_invoice['T'].values())==22461
  actual_delta={r:after['P'].get(r,0)-baseline_invoice['P'].get(r,0) for r in set(after['P'])|set(baseline_invoice['P']) if after['P'].get(r,0)!=baseline_invoice['P'].get(r,0)}
  assert actual_delta=={1:-51,2:17,4:-17,5:17} and after['T']==baseline_invoice['T'], 'Fresh complete signed #7620 comparison'
  candidate_invoice=read(FROZEN/'CANDIDATE-INVOICE.json')
  assert normal(after['P'])==candidate_invoice['paid'] and normal(after['T'])==candidate_invoice['targets']
  gate_path=FROZEN/'CONTACT7620-PRICE.json'
  assert sha256(gate_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='cfbdf2c1e5fd46e6c7cf8d24ee85e3de6cf94f438926c1cbe58306b738cde906'
  first_gate=read(gate_path)
  assert first_gate['status']=='PROVISIONAL_UNDER_COMMON_U' and first_gate['bindings']['candidate_canonical_sha256']=='03da65fb97ffaf4d0e9756f3867df588b162975f6015d8458821d05b5fcb006b'
  assert first_gate['bindings']['original_word_canonical_sha256']=='6c46ad38d812ae110392f1c977cc6f02665f8860e98ef1c21cb539ff3779533d' and first_gate['bindings']['old_invoice_sha256']=='61aaf72892d2bc2f9fac9dce37b3d62b01d15f4fa47e9f6fa2fceace7735b5ab'
  assert sha256((FROZEN/'CANDIDATE-INVOICE.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==first_gate['candidate_invoice']['sha256'], 'First-gate candidate invoice bytes'
  first_claim=Q(first_gate['claim']);first_probe=Q(first_gate['tested']);old_upper=Q(first_gate['old_published_raw_upper'])
  assert first_claim==Q('0.003661727792') and first_probe==Q('0.003661727792007') and old_upper<first_claim<first_probe
